name: 01 - self-play
note: A game played against self, recorded as fragments. Positions 2 and 3 exist in the notebook and are not yet entered. The record is open: men absent from a note were not written down, not necessarily captured.

observations.note: Recorded not in order of placement. Working read: b4 is the point of inflection / centre of balance / rotation.

position-1.name: A - push the gate
position-1.note: Commits to the a3-f8 diagonal. b5 opens the bishop and hits the knight; Nc3 backs b5 and adds a second attacker to d5. Rules out a rook on a3 for as long as the bishop stays.

position-1.name: B - keep the gate
position-1.note: Commits to the b2-h8 diagonal. Bb2 re-aims at e5 for free; e3 denies d4, the square that shields e5; the rook takes the square the bishop left. Nc3 is excluded here -- c3 blocks the new diagonal the same way b4 blocked the old.

position-1.name: C - probe first
position-1.note: The branch-neutral move. e3 denies d4 in both schemes and blocks neither diagonal, so it buys information about Black's intent before b4's bit is spent.
